check.description: The command that closes it when it passes, if it has one.

note.description: Present once done; null when it was closed without a note.

ActionId.description: A person action's id, such as A-2.

Activity.description: What a running seat last did, read from its run's output file.

last.description:
The tool it last ran or what it last said, on one line; `None`
before it has said anything.

quiet_seconds.description: Seconds since its output last changed.

AgentName.description:
An agent's configured name: a durable pseudonym for a seat, never a
real person's name. The configuration that declares it is scanned
like any other free text.

Audit.description: `ris audit`: the queue, or the review recorded.

Blocker.description: What an item can be blocked on.

decisions_left_out.description: Older decisions the brief had no room for.

path.description:
Relative to the project root; null when the built-in rules are
meant.

explanation.description: Null when no explanation is recorded.

oneOf.description:
A credential in a known format: an access key, an API token, a
bearer token, a JWT, or a long high-entropy string.
A PEM private-key block.
`password=`, `token:` and the like, followed by a value.
An email address.

An absolute path under a home directory or a drive root, which
carries a username or identifies a machine.

An entry from the local denylist: the person's name, a client's
name, the home directory, whatever the configuration lists.

CheckId.description: A check's name, as declared in the project's checks file.

CheckRun.description: One run of a check against an item.

CommandKind.description: The commands of the first slice, by kind.

oneOf.description: Raising a mechanical decision: logged, the item carries on.
Raising a substantive decision: queued, the item is set aside.
Recording a check's run against an item.
Returning a claimed item to ready: by its holder, or the person.
An auditor recording that it has reviewed an item.

Attaching the full case for an open decision: pros and cons per
option and why the recommendation holds.

The person replacing an item that has not been started with
another.
The person pausing seats, or resuming them.
The runner recording that a seat's agent started or stopped.
A seat reporting a fault in its setup.
Raising a person action; it sets aside the items it blocks.

The person recording an action done; items blocked only on it
return to ready.
The person giving an open action a check that closes it.

CommitHash.description: A git commit, by its full hash as git prints it.

unblocked.description: Items the decision alone had set aside, ready again.

Decide.description:
`ris decide`: a named decision taken, the walk's outcome, or with
`--json` and no decision the queue.

chosen.description:
The option taken; one past the offered options for an answer
outside them, which is then in `other`.

explained.description: Whether it has a full case (`ris eli5`).

raised_at_event.description:
The sequence number of the event that raised it; in
`ris show D-n` only.

DecisionClass.description: The decision rule: the test is the cost of reversing.

oneOf.description: The agent goes ahead and logs it.
Expensive to reverse: queued for the person.

DecisionId.description: A decision's id, such as D-4.

Edge.description: One connection, from the file that names the other.

kind.description: The kind of line that makes it: `mod` or `use` for Rust.

hits.description: `leak`: where, and never the matched text.

at.description:
When the shell appended it, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch;
0 when unknown (an event upgraded from format version 1).

hash.description: The chain hash of this event.

prev.description: The previous event's `hash`; all zeros for the first.

salt.description: `None` once the text has been removed.

text.description: `None` once the text has been removed.

text_hash.description: `H(salt, text)`, kept after the text is removed.

EvidenceId.description: A piece of evidence, addressed by the hash of its content.

why.description: Why the recommendation is the recommendation.

unlinked.description: How many nodes have no edge.

id.description: An item's, decision's or action's id.

Hash.description: A SHA-256 hash: 64 lowercase hex characters.

category.description: What kind of thing the scan found, in words.

line.description: Null when the hit is not on a line of the file (its name, say).

checks.description:
What running the person's action checks did; in the
command's own data, not where an inbox is part of another.

Inbox.description: `ris inbox`: the person's, or a seat's.

agent.description: The seat holding it, when claimed.

blocked_on.description: What it waits on, when blocked.

check_runs.description: Each run of one of its checks; in `ris show I-n` only.

decisions.description: The decisions about it; in `ris show I-n` only.

evidence.description: Its evidence, when done or merged.

waiting_on.description: The unmerged items a ready item depends on, when there are any.

ItemId.description: An item's id, such as I-7.

ItemRef.description: A command that names one item.

Logs.description:
`ris logs`: one seat's lines, every seat's, or when followed one
line per envelope.

diffs.description:
Each changed node's unified diff between `base` and `tip`, by
path, as `git diff` writes it; empty when `base` is null.

MapTests.description:
The test files `[map] tests` names, which are not nodes: how many
there are, how many the phase changed, and the lines it added and
removed in them.

tests.description: The test files left off the map.

MergedAhead.description: An item merged before a person action that informs it was done.

MessageId.description: A message's id, such as M-2.

MessageKind.description: What a message is for. No broadcasts and no free chat.

oneOf.description: Work passed from one agent to another.
Something a dependent item relies on changed.
A question to an item's owner.
An auditor's finding on an item.

Missing.description:
One thing a writing seat would lack. In `--json` output it is an
object whose `kind` is `program`, `write` or `network`.

oneOf.description: A check's program is not on the PATH a seat inherits.
A build tool's cache that `[runner] write` does not cover.
A registry host that `[runner] network` does not allow.

added.description: Lines the phase added and removed.

contract.description: Whether a `[map] contracts` pattern names it.

external.description: How it touches the outside; empty when it does not.

language.description:
The language its extension names; null for a contract file that
is not source code.

weight.description:
How much it should draw the eye: grows with the diff's size and
with being external or a contract.

closing_merge.description: What the closing merge did, in words.

PhaseId.description: A phase's id, such as P-3.

branch.description: The phase's branch; null when phase branches are off.

docs_item.description: The item added to bring the docs up to date, if one was.

preflight.description: What the writing seats would lack to run the checks.

messages.description: How many messages the log holds.

Refusal.description: Why a command was not applied.

oneOf.description:
A free-text field failed the confidentiality scan. The match is
never echoed: only the field and the category are named.

category.description: What kind of thing the scan found.

field.description: The field that was refused, as the caller named it.

oneOf.description: The command needs an open phase and there is none.
Only one phase is open at a time.
No item has this id.
No decision has this id.

The command is not allowed from the item's current state. The
transition table is the specification.

state.description: The item's state, as the table names it.

oneOf.description: The command is not allowed from the decision's current state.
The item depends on items that have not merged.
Only the agent holding an item may act on it.
Done means evidence; none was attached.
The chosen option is out of range.

A decision needs at least two options, and the recommendation
must be one of them.
A substantive decision is the person's to take.
A message must go to a named agent other than its sender.
An agent cannot audit an item it authored.
This agent has already reviewed this item.
Only the decision's raiser, or the person, explains it.

An explanation needs a summary, a reason for the recommendation,
and at least one pro or con for every option.
Replacing an item is the person's to do.
The seat is paused: it takes nothing new until resumed.
Pausing and resuming seats is the person's to do.
No action has this id.
The command is not allowed from the action's current state.
Only the person does a person action.
Only the person raises a person action: it is their own to-do.
Done means a result: evidence, or a note.
An action says what to do and how to tell it is done.
A merged or superseded item is settled; nothing new attaches to it.
The seat's agent is already running, since the given event.
No run of the seat's agent is recorded as running.

An item is replaced by another item that is not itself replaced
and does not depend, directly or through other items, on it.

phase.description: Null: no phase has been opened.

Report.description: `ris report`: the phase report, or that there is no phase yet.

oneOf.description:
Works beside the person: adds items, sends messages and raises
decisions for the person, and nothing else.

Salt.description: An event's salt: 32 lowercase hex characters.

Scanned.description: `ris scan`, clean. A hit is the `leak` error instead.

SeatRef.description: A command that names one seat.

SeatStopped.description: `ris seat start`: the run it waited for, once it has stopped.

status.description: The agent's exit status; null when a signal ended it.

SeatsSet.description:
`ris seat pause` and `ris seat resume`: one of `paused` and
`resumed`, the seats named.

finishing.description: What each paused seat holding an item finishes first.

Show.description: `ris show <id>`: the record the id names.

Structure.description:
The structural part of an event: everything the fold reads. No free
text lives here, by construction: none of these fields is a `Text`.

report.description: Taken over the log's head at close, not over the rendering.

oneOf.description:
A substantive decision was raised about a claimed item, which is
set aside until it is taken.
An item's blockers all cleared.
The person replaced a ready or blocked item with another.

A person action. The text part carries `what` and `done_when`.
Items it blocks are set aside by `ItemBlocked` events emitted
with it.

The person gave the action a check: a shell command that passes
once the action is done. The text part carries `check`.
The person did it. The text part carries `note`, if given.

The runner started a seat's agent. The text part carries
`runner` and, when configured, `model`: the binding behind the
seat's name for this run.
The seat's agent stopped, with its exit status when it had one.

A seat reported a fault in its setup: something its sandbox or
permissions do not let it do, for the person to fix in the
configuration. The text part carries `what`. The seat's next run
start clears it.

The person paused a seat: its next claim or audit is refused
until it is resumed. What it holds now it finishes.

An auditor reviewed a done or merged item. Findings travel as
messages; this records only that the review happened.

options.description:
How many options the text part carries, as `option.0` and so
on.

oneOf.description:
The full case for an open decision. The text part carries
`summary`, `why`, and `option.{n}.pro.{k}` and `option.{n}.con.{k}`
for the counts given here, one entry per option.

checks.description: What running the person's action checks did.

Tally.description:
What a phase came to: the items planned in it, the merges made while
it was open (an item carried in from an earlier phase counts where
it merged), and the items left unsettled, neither merged nor
superseded, which the next phase inherits.

Text.description: Free text that has passed the confidentiality scan.

missing_text.description: The sequence numbers of events whose text has been removed.

data.schema.description: This document: the JSON Schema of format 1.

envelope.failure.description: A failure. The exit status is not zero.

envelope.success.description: A successful outcome. `data` is the command's own: `#/$defs/data.<command>`.

description: Every outcome of every ris command run with --json is one envelope on stdout; a stream prints one envelope per line. The data of each command is under $defs as data.<command>, with _ for a space in the command. Objects are open: within a format keys are added, never removed, renamed or reshaped.
title: ris --json, format 1
